title: Posted programs repeat the same G1 point on consecutive lines (zero-length moves): 534 of 1671 lines on a plasma part, 240 in a 2D pocket

body:
Found by the QA swarm round 2 (#2582), briefs q01 and q06, CamCraft **v0.25.0** Linux x86_64 release.

## What happens

Posted programs often write the same point twice in a row, after rounding to the output precision, and every arc (G2/G3) is followed by a G1 to its own end point. Count of consecutive identical G0/G1 lines:

| program | post | lines | repeated |
|---|---|---|---|
| q06-bracket.nc (Plasma Profile, Tormach 1300PL) | Tormach PathPilot Plasma | 1671 | 534 |
| q06-punch.nc (Wire Contour, Sodick ALC400G) | Sodick Wire EDM (Mark 21) | 789 | 80 |
| q01-2d-plate.nc (2D Pocket + Contour, 770MX) | Tormach PathPilot | 2352 | 240 |

Example (q06-bracket.nc lines 20-34):

```
G3 X32.077 Y33.706 I-3.009 J-2.832
G1 X32.077 Y33.706
G3 X31.146 Y34.092 I-2.036 J-3.598
G1 X31.146 Y34.092
G1 X31.072 Y34.111
G1 X31.034 Y34.121
G1 X31.034 Y34.121
```

The moves are harmless in geometry but bloat the file, and on plasma and wire controls a zero-length block can cost a look-ahead stop (a dwell mark on plasma).

## Expected

A move whose posted coordinates equal the previous position is not written (each post, or once in the shared output layer).

## Repro files

[q06-bracket.nc](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/round2-20261122/q06-wire-plasma/q06-bracket.nc), [q06-bracket.camproj](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/round2-20261122/q06-wire-plasma/q06-bracket.camproj), [q06-punch.nc](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/round2-20261122/q06-wire-plasma/q06-punch.nc), [q01-2d-plate.nc](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/round2-20261122/q01-2d-plate/q01-2d-plate.nc).

Done means: re-posting these projects writes no consecutive identical motion line (pinned by a post test), with the toolpath and the verify verdict unchanged.
